verdict.rationale: Evidence covers teleoperation via web-based manual control (drive bases, move arms, test panels) and fleet monitoring/alerting, but there is no documented workflow for detecting an autonomy failure, escalating it to a human intervention queue, or handing control back to autonomy after operator resolution. missing for 10: failure detection/escalation logic, an intervention queue/ticketing mechanism, and documented handback-to-autonomy flow.
